job.title: AI Engineer, Internal Tools
job.location: San Francisco, CA · New York, NY · Remote (US)
job.workplace: US hub or remote in the US
job.pay_full: $153,000 – $296,000 a year base salary, plus equity

details.about: Figma's platform helps teams take ideas from brainstorm and prototype to code, working together in real time. Its Internal AI team, part of the Business Technology org, helps every Figma employee — from Sales and Support to Finance, People and Legal — adopt AI safely and use it to improve how they work. The team is small and organised around three pillars (Platform & Tooling, Infrastructure & Hosting, Applied AI Builds); this role is a key member of Applied AI Builds, owning AI solutions from discovery through production.
duties: Partner with GTM, Finance, People, Legal, Support and other teams to understand their workflows and find high-value uses for AI
Design, build and run in production AI agents, assistants and workflow automations using LLMs, tool calling, RAG, structured outputs, agent frameworks, MCP, APIs and enterprise data
Integrate AI applications with enterprise systems, data sources and internal APIs
Build evaluations and feedback loops that measure accuracy, reliability and business impact
Design deterministic guardrails, human-in-the-loop controls and approval patterns where AI takes business-critical actions
Build production systems with strong observability, failure handling, security, authentication, authorization and auditability
Turn patterns that repeat across projects into shared components with the Internal AI platform teams
Help define how Figma approaches applied AI engineering and scales AI adoption
needs: 5+ years of software engineering building production applications, integrations, backend systems or AI-powered products
Hands-on experience building with LLMs, agents, retrieval-augmented generation, function calling, schema-constrained outputs or evaluation frameworks
Experience taking an AI application or workflow beyond a prototype and operating it in production

Strong API, integration and system design fundamentals, judgment on when AI or a rules-based approach is right, and experience with observability, failure handling, authentication, authorization and security controls
Experience working with non-engineering stakeholders to turn ambiguous business problems into technical solutions, moving quickly from discovery to prototype
nice: Background building internal AI applications or in an Applied AI, Forward Deployed Engineering or AI Solutions Engineering role
Experience with MCP, agent orchestration frameworks and enterprise tool-calling patterns
Knowledge of AWS Bedrock, AgentCore, OpenAI, Anthropic or similar AI platforms
Experience integrating systems such as Salesforce, Zendesk, Workday, NetSuite, Greenhouse or Slack
Knowledge of AI evaluations, observability, prompt/version management and human-in-the-loop systems
Experience with enterprise identity and access (Okta, SSO, OAuth, service-to-service authentication) within Security, Privacy or SOX/ITGC requirements
details.benefits: Annual base salary $153,000 – $296,000; level and pay depend on qualifications, market and work location. Figma offers equity and benefits including health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits with company contributions, parental leave and reproductive or family planning support, mental health and wellness benefits, and paid time off (flexible PTO for exempt employees), plus paid sick leave and holidays. Additional benefits may include company recharge days, cell phone and home internet reimbursements and lifestyle spending accounts; eligible non-sales roles have an annual bonus plan.
notes: Full time, from one of Figma's US hubs or remotely in the United States
Candidates may submit up to 5 applications to Figma in any rolling 30-day period
Cameras must be on during video interviews, and new hires attend in-person onboarding
Figma encourages applicants whose experience doesn't match every point to apply anyway
